answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 276 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is contact lens jaiz and what is the daleel? Who is Shaykh Yunis of India? Question: Is contact lens jaiz and what is the daleel? Who is Shaykh Yunis of India? Answer ID: 276 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 141=140/L) If you mean the contact lens of eyes, then there is no matter whatsoever. It is a kind of treatment and does not involve anything forbidden. Therefore, it is allowed. Shaikh Yunus is the Shaikhul Hadith of Mazahir Uloom and a prominent Khalifa of Hazrat Shaikh Zakariya. He enjoys good mastery over sciences of Hadith and has been teaching Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim for a long time in Mazahir Uloom Saharanpur. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
